record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

This day<WH03117> came ye out<WH03318><WTH8802> in the month<WH02320> Abib<WH024>.

And it shall be when the LORD<WH03068> shall bring<WH0935><WTH8686> thee into the land<WH0776> of the Canaanites<WH03669>, and the Hittites<WH02850>, and the Amorites<WH0567>, and the Hivites<WH02340>, and the Jebusites<WH02983>, which he sware<WH07650><WTH8738> unto thy fathers<WH01> to give<WH05414><WTH8800> thee, a land<WH0776> flowing<WH02100><WTH8802> with milk<WH02461> and honey<WH01706>, that thou shalt keep<WH05647><WTH8804> this service<WH05656> in this month<WH02320>.
Seven<WH07651> days<WH03117> thou shalt eat<WH0398><WTH8799> unleavened bread<WH04682>, and in the seventh<WH07637> day<WH03117> <FI>shall be<Fi> a feast<WH02282> to the LORD<WH03068>.

Unleavened bread<WH04682> shall be eaten<WH0398><WTH8735> seven<WH07651> days<WH03117>; and there shall no leavened bread<WH02557> be seen<WH07200><WTH8735> with thee, neither shall there be leaven<WH07603> seen<WH07200><WTH8735> with thee in all thy quarters<WH01366>.

And thou shalt shew<WH05046><WTH8689> thy son<WH01121> in that day<WH03117>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, <FI>This is done<Fi> because of<WH05668> that<WH02088> <FI>which<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> did<WH06213><WTH8804> unto me when I came forth<WH03318><WTH8800> out of Egypt<WH04714>.

And it shall be for a sign<WH0226> unto thee upon thine hand<WH03027>, and for a memorial<WH02146> between thine eyes<WH05869>, that the LORD'S<WH03068> law<WH08451> may be in thy mouth<WH06310>: for with a strong<WH02389> hand<WH03027> hath the LORD<WH03068> brought thee out<WH03318><WTH8689> of Egypt<WH04714>.
Thou shalt therefore keep<WH08104><WTH8804> this ordinance<WH02708> in his season<WH04150> from year<WH03117> to year<WH03117>.<CM>

And it shall be when the LORD<WH03068> shall bring<WH0935><WTH8686> thee into the land<WH0776> of the Canaanites<WH03669>, as he sware<WH07650><WTH8738> unto thee and to thy fathers<WH01>, and shall give<WH05414><WTH8804> it thee,

That thou shalt set apart<WH05674><WTH8689> unto the LORD<WH03068> all that openeth<WH06363> the matrix<WH07358>, and every firstling<WH06363> that cometh<WH07698> of a beast<WH0929> which thou hast; the males<WH02145> <FI>shall be<Fi> the LORD'S<WH03068>. <RF>set...: Heb. cause to pass over<Rf>

And every firstling<WH06363> of an ass<WH02543> thou shalt redeem<WH06299><WTH8799> with a lamb<WH07716>; and if thou wilt not redeem<WH06299><WTH8799> it, then thou shalt break his neck<WH06202><WTH8804>: and all the firstborn<WH01060> of man<WH0120> among thy children<WH01121> shalt thou redeem<WH06299><WTH8799>. <RF>lamb: or, kid<Rf>

And it shall be when thy son<WH01121> asketh<WH07592><WTH8799> thee in time to come<WH04279>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, What <FI>is<Fi> this? that thou shalt say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto him, By strength<WH02392> of hand<WH03027> the LORD<WH03068> brought us out<WH03318><WTH8689> from Egypt<WH04714>, from the house<WH01004> of bondage<WH05650>: <RF>in...: Heb. to morrow<Rf>

And it came to pass, when Pharaoh<WH06547> would hardly<WH07185><WTH8689> let us go<WH07971><WTH8763>, that the LORD<WH03068> slew<WH02026><WTH8799> all the firstborn<WH01060> in the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>, both the firstborn<WH01060> of man<WH0120>, and the firstborn<WH01060> of beast<WH0929>: therefore I sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8802> to the LORD<WH03068> all that openeth<WH06363> the matrix<WH07358>, being males<WH02145>; but all the firstborn<WH01060> of my children<WH01121> I redeem<WH06299><WTH8799>.

And it shall be for a token<WH0226> upon thine hand<WH03027>, and for frontlets<WH02903> between thine eyes<WH05869>: for by strength<WH02392> of hand<WH03027> the LORD<WH03068> brought us forth<WH03318><WTH8689> out of Egypt<WH04714>.<CM>

And it came to pass, when Pharaoh<WH06547> had let the people<WH05971> go<WH07971><WTH8763>, that God<WH0430> led<WH05148><WTH8804> them not <FI>through<Fi> the way<WH01870> of the land<WH0776> of the Philistines<WH06430>, although<WH03588> that <FI>was<Fi> near<WH07138>; for God<WH0430> said<WH0559><WTH8804>, Lest peradventure the people<WH05971> repent<WH05162><WTH8735> when they see<WH07200><WTH8800> war<WH04421>, and they return<WH07725><WTH8804> to Egypt<WH04714>:

But God<WH0430> led<WH05437><WH00> the people<WH05971> about<WH05437><WTH8686>, <FI>through<Fi> the way<WH01870> of the wilderness<WH04057> of the Red<WH05488> sea<WH03220>: and the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> went up<WH05927><WTH8804> harnessed<WH02571> out of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>. <RF>harnessed: or, by five in a rank<Rf>

And Moses<WH04872> took<WH03947><WTH8799> the bones<WH06106> of Joseph<WH03130> with him: for he had straitly<WH07650><WTH8687> sworn<WH07650><WTH8689> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, God<WH0430> will surely<WH06485><WTH8800> visit<WH06485><WTH8799> you; and ye shall carry up<WH05927><WH00> my bones<WH06106> away<WH05927><WTH8689> hence with you.
And they took their journey<WH05265><WTH8799> from Succoth<WH05523>, and encamped<WH02583><WTH8799> in Etham<WH0864>, in the edge<WH07097> of the wilderness<WH04057>.

And the LORD<WH03068> went<WH01980><WTH8802> before<WH06440> them by day<WH03119> in a pillar<WH05982> of a cloud<WH06051>, to lead<WH05148><WTH8687> them the way<WH01870>; and by night<WH03915> in a pillar<WH05982> of fire<WH0784>, to give them light<WH0215><WTH8687>; to go<WH03212><WTH8800> by day<WH03119> and night<WH03915>:
